name: efficiency-marketplace

plugins.name: info-card
plugins.description: A live spend card above the prompt (cost, tokens, context, 5-hour limit, cache health, task) plus /ledger for spend by tool and prompt-cache detail.

plugins.name: haiku-agents
plugins.description: Three read-only Haiku subagents (finder, scoper, junior) that keep searches and checks out of your main context at a fraction of the cost.

plugins.name: context-diet
plugins.description: /diet ranks what fills your context before you type (MCP servers, skills, agents, memory files) so you can switch off what you do not use.

plugins.name: reread-guard
plugins.description: Refuses to re-read an unchanged file that is already in context, so the same text is not added and re-billed every turn.

plugins.name: lean-skills
plugins.description: Three small skills (lean-search, scope-first, handoff) that make Claude search, scope edits and reset long sessions the cheap way.

description: Claude Code plugins for tracking usage and spending less of it: status displays, and cheap Haiku subagents.
